newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bounced checks lower in December - banks.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bounced checks lower in December - banks.

text.p: The number of bounced checks in Brazil fell 15.34 percent in December against the previous month, the Centralized Bank Services (Serasa) said.

Serasa said in a statement 0.37 percent of the total 295 million checks cleared last month were bounced. The level of bounced checks in Brazil, which is still very high, is expected to drop only in the second half of 1997, it added.

The use of checks in Brazil has been falling since mid-1994, when the government began its anti-inflation drive, due to an increase in the use of cash and credit cards. In 1996, Brazilian banks cleared 3 billion checks against the 4.1 billion checks cleared in 1994, Serasa said.
